insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented the requested optimization patterns (unbind and padding handling) despite the repository being in a different state than the task description suggested. It showed strong technical reasoning but failed on process constraints, specifically turn-count management.
strengths: Excellent use of git tools to understand codebase evolution.
Accurate translation of optimization patterns from one version of the code to another.
weaknesses: Failed to verify performance improvements due to environment limitations (no GPU) and didn't seek alternatives.
